title: Groundwater quality dataset and analysis code for reduced metal testing in Faisalabad District, Pakistan
description:
Groundwater quality data and analysis code for the article "Evaluating machine learning for reduced groundwater testing through index prediction and metal exceedance detection in Faisalabad, Indus Basin, Pakistan" (Journal of Hydrology: Regional Studies, submitted).
The dataset covers 457 groundwater sources sampled in February 2026 across Faisalabad District, Punjab, Pakistan (Rechna Doab, Indus Basin): 278 tube wells, 148 taps fed by on-site pumps and 31 hand pumps in agricultural, industrial and urban zones. Each record gives WGS84 coordinates, land-use zone, source type, field pH, EC, TDS and temperature, and dissolved As, Cd, Pb, Cr and Hg. Site names are removed.
The ZIP archive contains the full Python pipeline (nested spatial cross-validation, reduced-panel search, index and screening models, zone transfer), the analysis protocol, all compiled outputs, the train/test split records, figure and table scripts, and a verification script that regenerates the splits and recomputes the published results.
